rows.name: Gardenstown
rows.description: Shown on E. quay-head, in br. and red sectors

rows.name: Macduff
rows.character: One br. or red fixed lt.
rows.description: On the W. pier-head. Is red when the harbour is open

rows.name: Banff
rows.description: One white light on N. pier-head. One high white lt., with lower red lt., in the upper part of the new harbour; visible when entrance is open. In one, S.E. ¾ S., lead in ...

rows.name: Elgin and Lossiemouth
rows.description: One green light on South pier-head

rows.name: COVESEA SKERRIES
rows.description: Stone tower, 118 ft., on Craig Head. It is red to E., in Spey Bay, from S.E. by E. ¼ E., to S.E. ½ S. The rest is bright

rows.name: Chanonry Point
rows.description: A stone tower, 42 ft. high, on the point

rows.name: Cromarty Point
rows.description: A tower, 42 ft. high, on the point

rows.name: TARBET NESS
rows.character: One intermittent lt.; br. 2½ min., eclipsed ½ m.
rows.description: Stone tower, 134 ft. high, 430 yards from extreme. Within Moray Frith, from S. ¾ W. to S.W. ¼ W. light is continuous (fixed)

rows.name: Little Ferry
rows.description: Occasionally; on N. side, N.W. ½ N., 1,800 ft. apart

rows.name: Latheronwheel
rows.description: Occasionally; on South head, at the end of fishing season

rows.name: Wick or Pulteney Town
rows.description: On the North pier-head; red lt. on new breakwater

rows.name: NOSS HEAD
rows.description: Bright light seaward; in Sinclair Bay, from N.E. ¾ N. to W.N.W., the lt. is red

rows.name: PENTLAND SKERRIES
rows.description: Two stone towers, 118 and 88 ft. high, N.N.E. and S.S.W., 100 ft. apart

rows.name: DUNNET HEAD
rows.description: A stone tower, 66 ft. high, on the northernmost point of Scotland

rows.name: Little Holburn Head
rows.description: Tower, 55 ft. high. Light white toward Pentland Firth; red West of S.S.W., in Scrabster Road

rows.name: CANTICK
rows.description: A white brick tower, 73 ft. high, on the head, Hoy Island

rows.name: Hoy Sound, Gremsa Id.
rows.character: High light, red or white Low light, bright
rows.description: The bright low light is on the N.W. point, and is visible N. of E. ½ S. and W. ½ N. The high lt., on N.E. point, is red to seaward, but br. from N.N.W. ¼ W. to E.N.E. A ray of light is shown toward E. entrance of Hoy Sound, between S.S.E. ½ E. and S. ½ E. In one, S.E. ½ E., they lead in mid-channel from westward. They are 2,237 yds. apart.

rows.name: Kirkwall
rows.description: On the pier-head, from August to April

rows.name: AUSKERRY
rows.description: White brick tower, 112 ft. high, on S. point of island, in Stronza Firth
